lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你不是很喜歡你租的那間老房子嗎？怎麼突然搬到宿舍來了？
lines.simplified: 你不是很喜欢你租的那间老房子吗？怎么突然搬到宿舍来了？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bú shì hěn xǐhuān nǐ zū de nà jiān lǎo fángzi ma? Zěnme túrán bān dào sùshè lái le?
lines.english: Didn't you really like that old house you rented? Why have you suddenly moved into the dorm?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那間房子雖然老，可是住了幾十年都沒事，我以為很安全，沒想到上個星期地震，屋頂就塌了一塊。
lines.simplified: 那间房子虽然老，可是住了几十年都没事，我以为很安全，没想到上个星期地震，屋顶就塌了一块。
lines.pinyin: Nà jiān fángzi suīrán lǎo, kěshì zhù le jǐ shí nián dōu méi shì, wǒ yǐwéi hěn ānquán, méixiǎngdào shàng ge xīngqí dìzhèn, wūdǐng jiù tā le yí kuài.
lines.english: That house was old, but it had stood for decades with no trouble, so I thought it was safe. I never expected that in last week's earthquake part of the roof would collapse.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 真糟糕！還好你運氣不錯，那時候不在家。
lines.simplified: 真糟糕！还好你运气不错，那时候不在家。
lines.pinyin: Zhēn zāogāo! Háihǎo nǐ yùnqì búcuò, nà shíhòu bú zài jiā.
lines.english: How awful! Luckily you were fortunate enough not to be at home then.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 是啊，要不然可能就被困在底下了。房東說要修兩三個月，我只好先搬出來。
lines.simplified: 是啊，要不然可能就被困在底下了。房东说要修两三个月，我只好先搬出来。
lines.pinyin: Shì a, yàobùrán kěnéng jiù bèi kùn zài dǐxià le. Fángdōng shuō yào xiū liǎng sān ge yuè, wǒ zhǐhǎo xiān bān chūlái.
lines.english: Yes, otherwise I might have been trapped underneath. The landlord says the repairs will take two or three months, so I had to move out for now.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 請問下面哪一個是對的？
prompt.simplified: 请问下面哪一个是对的？
prompt.pinyin: Qǐngwèn xiàmiàn nǎ yí ge shì duì de?
prompt.english: Which of the following is true?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Wūdǐng zhěng ge dōu tā le.
choices.english: The whole roof collapsed.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zhè liǎng sān ge yuè bù néng zhù rén.
choices.english: Nobody can live there for the next two or three months.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nán de zǎo jiù juéde bù ānquán.
choices.english: The man had long thought it unsafe.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dìzhèn shí nán de zài wūzi lǐ.
choices.english: The man was in the house during the earthquake.

questions.why: The repairs take two or three months and he had to move out, so the house cannot be lived in for now. Only a piece of the roof fell (塌了一塊), not all of it; 我以為……沒想到 shows he had thought the old house was fine, and the woman says he was lucky not to be home (要不然可能就被困在底下了).

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 颱風天妳不是要在家看一整天的書嗎？怎麼看起來這麼累？
lines.simplified: 台风天你不是要在家看一整天的书吗？怎么看起来这么累？
lines.pinyin: Táifēng tiān nǐ bú shì yào zài jiā kàn yì zhěng tiān de shū ma? Zěnme kàn qǐlái zhème lèi?
lines.english: Weren't you going to stay home reading all day during the typhoon? Why do you look so tired?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我以為只會停一下電，點了蠟燭繼續看，沒想到一連停了十幾個小時。
lines.simplified: 我以为只会停一下电，点了蜡烛继续看，没想到一连停了十几个小时。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi zhǐ huì tíng yíxià diàn, diǎn le làzhú jìxù kàn, méixiǎngdào yìlián tíng le shí jǐ ge xiǎoshí.
lines.english: I thought the power cut would be over in a moment, so I lit a candle and kept reading. But it stayed off for more than ten hours straight.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 真糟糕，那麼久啊？
lines.simplified: 真糟糕，那么久啊？
lines.pinyin: Zhēn zāogāo, nàme jiǔ a?
lines.english: That's awful. That long?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 是啊，而且外面的風雨聲那麼大，我一直睡不著。
lines.simplified: 是啊，而且外面的风雨声那么大，我一直睡不着。
lines.pinyin: Shì a, érqiě wàimiàn de fēngyǔshēng nàme dà, wǒ yìzhí shuì bù zháo.
lines.english: Yes, and the wind and rain outside were so loud that I couldn't get to sleep.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的本來以為停電會怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 女的本来以为停电会怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de běnlái yǐwéi tíngdiàn huì zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What did the woman expect of the power cut at first?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Huì tíng shí jǐ ge xiǎoshí.
choices.english: It would last over ten hours.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Huì tíng zhěngzhěng yì tiān.
choices.english: It would last a whole day.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Hěn kuài jiù huì yǒu diàn.
choices.english: The power would soon be back.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Wǎnshàng cái huì tíngdiàn.
choices.english: It would only happen at night.

questions.why: 我以為只會停一下電: she expected the power to be off only for a moment. 沒想到 introduces what really happened: over ten hours in a row. A whole day is how long she planned to read, not how long she expected the cut to last.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 媽媽，颱風跟臺灣的距離還很遠，我去超市買點菜跟水吧。
lines.simplified: 妈妈，台风跟台湾的距离还很远，我去超市买点菜跟水吧。
lines.pinyin: Māma, táifēng gēn Táiwān de jùlí hái hěn yuǎn, wǒ qù chāoshì mǎi diǎn cài gēn shuǐ ba.
lines.english: Mom, the typhoon is still a long way from Taiwan. Let me go to the supermarket for some vegetables and water.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 電視上說，大家一下班就去搶，菜早就被搶光了，價格也提高了。家裡的泡麵夠吃一個星期，你還是先去外婆家，幫她把窗戶關好吧。
lines.simplified: 电视上说，大家一下班就去抢，菜早就被抢光了，价格也提高了。家里的泡面够吃一个星期，你还是先去外婆家，帮她把窗户关好吧。
lines.pinyin: Diànshì shàng shuō, dàjiā yí xiàbān jiù qù qiǎng, cài zǎo jiù bèi qiǎng guāng le, jiàgé yě tígāo le. Jiālǐ de pàomiàn gòu chī yí ge xīngqí, nǐ háishì xiān qù wàipó jiā, bāng tā bǎ chuānghù guān hǎo ba.
lines.english: The TV says everyone rushed to grab things as soon as they got off work: the vegetables were snatched up long ago, and prices have gone up too. We have enough instant noodles at home for a week. You'd better go to Grandma's first and help her shut her windows properly.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 也好，她一個人住，萬一窗戶被吹壞了就麻煩了。
lines.simplified: 也好，她一个人住，万一窗户被吹坏了就麻烦了。
lines.pinyin: Yěhǎo, tā yí ge rén zhù, wànyī chuānghù bèi chuī huài le jiù máfan le.
lines.english: All right. She lives alone, and if her windows got blown in, that would be a real problem.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 媽媽要兒子先做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 妈妈要儿子先做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Māma yào érzi xiān zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What does the mother want her son to do first?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qù chāoshì mǎi shūcài.
choices.english: Go to the supermarket for vegetables.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Huíjiā zhǔnbèi pàomiàn.
choices.english: Go home and get instant noodles ready.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bǎ jiālǐ de chuānghù guān hǎo.
choices.english: Shut the windows at home.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qù wàipó jiā bāngmáng.
choices.english: Go and help at Grandma's.

questions.why: 你還是先去外婆家，幫她把窗戶關好吧: after weighing it up, she tells him to help Grandma first. The supermarket is his plan, which she talks him out of; the noodles are already at home, and the windows are Grandma's, not theirs.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我的電腦還在三樓的教室裡，我想上去拿。
lines.simplified: 我的电脑还在三楼的教室里，我想上去拿。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ de diànnǎo hái zài sān lóu de jiàoshì lǐ, wǒ xiǎng shàngqù ná.
lines.english: My computer is still in the classroom on the third floor. I want to go up and get it.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 剛剛的地震那麼大，誰知道等一下還會不會再來一次？老師也說大家先在操場集合，不要回去。
lines.simplified: 刚刚的地震那么大，谁知道等一下还会不会再来一次？老师也说大家先在操场集合，不要回去。
lines.pinyin: Gānggāng de dìzhèn nàme dà, shéi zhīdào děng yíxià hái huì bú huì zài lái yí cì? Lǎoshī yě shuō dàjiā xiān zài cāochǎng jíhé, bú yào huíqù.
lines.english: That earthquake just now was so big. Who knows whether another one will come in a moment? The teacher also said everyone should gather on the sports field first and not go back in.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 可是我等一下要用電腦交報告。
lines.simplified: 可是我等一下要用电脑交报告。
lines.pinyin: Kěshì wǒ děng yíxià yào yòng diànnǎo jiāo bàogào.
lines.english: But I need the computer to hand in a report soon.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你還是等學校檢查完大樓再上去拿吧，報告晚一點交，老師不會說什麼的。
lines.simplified: 你还是等学校检查完大楼再上去拿吧，报告晚一点交，老师不会说什么的。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ háishì děng xuéxiào jiǎnchá wán dàlóu zài shàngqù ná ba, bàogào wǎn yìdiǎn jiāo, lǎoshī bú huì shuō shénme de.
lines.english: You'd better wait until the school has checked the building before you go up for it. If the report is a bit late, the teacher won't mind.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 女的是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the woman mean?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiànzài shàng lóu hái bù ānquán.
choices.english: It isn't safe to go upstairs yet.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Lǎoshī huì bāng tā ná diànnǎo.
choices.english: The teacher will get the computer for him.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bàogào búyòng jiāo le.
choices.english: The report no longer has to be handed in.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dàjiā yào huí jiàoshì shàngkè.
choices.english: Everyone has to go back to class.

questions.why: She fears another quake and tells him to wait until the building is checked (你還是等……再上去拿吧): going up now is not safe. She says the report can be a little late, not that it is cancelled, and the teacher told everyone to stay on the field.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我們這棟樓一連停了兩天水，我連衣服都沒辦法洗，廚房的螞蟻也越來越多。
lines.simplified: 我们这栋楼一连停了两天水，我连衣服都没办法洗，厨房的蚂蚁也越来越多。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen zhè dòng lóu yìlián tíng le liǎng tiān shuǐ, wǒ lián yīfú dōu méi bànfǎ xǐ, chúfáng de mǎyǐ yě yuè lái yuè duō.
lines.english: Our building has had no water for two days in a row. I can't even wash my clothes, and there are more and more ants in the kitchen.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 大樓的管理人員說，屋頂上送水的設備被颱風吹壞了，今天下午就會有人來修。
lines.simplified: 大楼的管理人员说，屋顶上送水的设备被台风吹坏了，今天下午就会有人来修。
lines.pinyin: Dàlóu de guǎnlǐ rényuán shuō, wūdǐng shàng sòng shuǐ de shèbèi bèi táifēng chuī huài le, jīntiān xiàwǔ jiù huì yǒu rén lái xiū.
lines.english: The building manager says the water equipment on the roof was broken by the typhoon, and someone will come to fix it this afternoon.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 他昨天也是這麼說的。
lines.simplified: 他昨天也是这么说的。
lines.pinyin: Tā zuótiān yě shì zhème shuō de.
lines.english: That's what he said yesterday too.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 男的是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the man mean?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā pà jīntiān yě xiū bù hǎo.
choices.english: He fears it won't be fixed today either.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Shèbèi zuótiān jiù xiū hǎo le.
choices.english: The equipment was fixed yesterday.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tāmen cái tíng le yì tiān shuǐ.
choices.english: They have only been without water for one day.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā yào zìjǐ zhǎo rén lái xiū.
choices.english: He will find someone to fix it himself.

questions.why: The building manager promised the same thing yesterday and the water has now been off two days in a row (一連停了兩天水), so the man doubts today's promise. The equipment was not fixed yesterday, the cut is two days, not one, and he does not say he will find his own repairman.

focus.en: in a row; what the speaker means

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你家門口那棵大樹怎麼不見了？
lines.simplified: 你家门口那棵大树怎么不见了？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ jiā ménkǒu nà kē dà shù zěnme bú jiàn le?
lines.english: What happened to the big tree outside your door?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 上個月一連來了兩個颱風。第一個來的時候，它還好好的；第二個一來，就被吹倒了，還把旁邊的路燈弄壞了。
lines.simplified: 上个月一连来了两个台风。第一个来的时候，它还好好的；第二个一来，就被吹倒了，还把旁边的路灯弄坏了。
lines.pinyin: Shàng ge yuè yìlián lái le liǎng ge táifēng. Dì yī ge lái de shíhòu, tā hái hǎohǎo de; dì èr ge yì lái, jiù bèi chuī dǎo le, hái bǎ pángbiān de lùdēng nòng huài le.
lines.english: Last month two typhoons came one after the other. When the first came, it was still fine; as soon as the second arrived, it was blown over and broke the street lamp next to it.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 真可惜，這附近的樹木本來就不多，以前夏天大家都在那棵樹底下聊天。
lines.simplified: 真可惜，这附近的树木本来就不多，以前夏天大家都在那棵树底下聊天。
lines.pinyin: Zhēn kěxí, zhè fùjìn de shùmù běnlái jiù bù duō, yǐqián xiàtiān dàjiā dōu zài nà kē shù dǐxià liáotiān.
lines.english: What a pity. There weren't many trees round here to begin with, and in summer everyone used to chat under that one.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 聽說社區明年會再種一棵。
lines.simplified: 听说社区明年会再种一棵。
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō shèqū míngnián huì zài zhòng yì kē.
lines.english: I hear the neighbourhood will plant another one next year.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 下面哪一個是對的？
prompt.simplified: 下面哪一个是对的？
prompt.pinyin: Xiàmiàn nǎ yí ge shì duì de?
prompt.english: Which of the following is true?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 第一個颱風來時就倒了
choices.simplified: 第一个台风来时就倒了
choices.pinyin: Dì yī ge táifēng lái shí jiù dǎo le.
choices.english: It fell when the first typhoon came.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dǎo de shíhòu méi nòng huài dōngxi.
choices.english: It broke nothing when it fell.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 以前很少人在樹下聊天
choices.simplified: 以前很少人在树下聊天
choices.pinyin: Yǐqián hěn shǎo rén zài shù xià liáotiān.
choices.english: Few people used to chat under it.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 附近的樹木變得更少了
choices.simplified: 附近的树木变得更少了
choices.pinyin: Fùjìn de shùmù biàn de gèng shǎo le.
choices.english: There are now even fewer trees nearby.

questions.why: The woman says there were few trees round here to begin with (本來就不多), and now the big one is gone and the new one will only come next year: there are even fewer. It stood through the first typhoon and fell in the second (一連來了兩個……第二個一來), it broke the street lamp, and everyone used to chat under it.

focus.en: in a row; putting two turns together

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 颱風天不能出門，你這兩天都在家做什麼？
lines.simplified: 台风天不能出门，你这两天都在家做什么？
lines.pinyin: Táifēng tiān bù néng chūmén, nǐ zhè liǎng tiān dōu zài jiā zuò shénme?
lines.english: You can't go out in a typhoon. What have you been doing at home these two days?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 不是看電視，就是玩手機。本來想整理房間，想來想去，還是等颱風走了再說吧。
lines.simplified: 不是看电视，就是玩手机。本来想整理房间，想来想去，还是等台风走了再说吧。
lines.pinyin: Bú shì kàn diànshì, jiù shì wán shǒujī. Běnlái xiǎng zhěnglǐ fángjiān, xiǎng lái xiǎng qù, háishì děng táifēng zǒu le zài shuō ba.
lines.english: If I'm not watching TV, I'm on my phone. I meant to tidy my room, but after thinking it over, I'll leave it until the typhoon has gone.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我看你本來就不打算整理吧。
lines.simplified: 我看你本来就不打算整理吧。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ kàn nǐ běnlái jiù bù dǎsuàn zhěnglǐ ba.
lines.english: I think you never meant to tidy up in the first place.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的覺得男的為什麼還沒整理房間？
prompt.simplified: 女的觉得男的为什么还没整理房间？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de juéde nán de wèishénme hái méi zhěnglǐ fángjiān?
prompt.english: Why does the woman think the man hasn't tidied his room yet?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Táifēng tiān bú shìhé zhěnglǐ.
choices.english: A typhoon day is no time for tidying.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā máng zhe kàn diànshì wán shǒujī.
choices.english: He is busy with TV and his phone.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā qíshí zhǐshì bù xiǎng zhěnglǐ.
choices.english: He simply doesn't want to.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他要等颱風來了再整理
choices.simplified: 他要等台风来了再整理
choices.pinyin: Tā yào děng táifēng lái le zài zhěnglǐ.
choices.english: He will tidy once the typhoon arrives.

questions.why: 我看你本來就不打算整理吧: she thinks waiting for the typhoon to pass is only an excuse, so in her eyes he simply does not want to tidy up. Waiting for the typhoon is his own reason, which she rejects; TV and the phone are what he has been doing, not why in her eyes; and he said he would wait until the typhoon has gone (走了), not come.

focus.zh: 不是……，就是……；說話人的意思
focus.en: if not…, then…; what the speaker means

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我要去超商買電池，要不要順便幫妳買什麼？
lines.simplified: 我要去超商买电池，要不要顺便帮你买什么？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yào qù chāoshāng mǎi diànchí, yào bú yào shùnbiàn bāng nǐ mǎi shénme?
lines.english: I'm going to the convenience store for batteries. Shall I get you anything while I'm there?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 不用了，水跟電池我早就準備好了。你家有收音機嗎？萬一停電，就只能聽廣播了。
lines.simplified: 不用了，水跟电池我早就准备好了。你家有收音机吗？万一停电，就只能听广播了。
lines.pinyin: Búyòng le, shuǐ gēn diànchí wǒ zǎo jiù zhǔnbèi hǎo le. Nǐ jiā yǒu shōuyīnjī ma? Wànyī tíngdiàn, jiù zhǐ néng tīng guǎngbò le.
lines.english: No need. I got water and batteries ready long ago. Do you have a radio at home? If the power goes, the radio will be all you have.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 沒有。算了，用手機聽也好。
lines.simplified: 没有。算了，用手机听也好。
lines.pinyin: Méiyǒu. Suànle, yòng shǒujī tīng yěhǎo.
lines.english: No. Never mind, the phone will do.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 停電的時候，手機也會沒電啊。
lines.simplified: 停电的时候，手机也会没电啊。
lines.pinyin: Tíngdiàn de shíhòu, shǒujī yě huì méi diàn a.
lines.english: When the power is out, your phone runs flat too.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的最後說的話是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 女的最后说的话是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de zuìhòu shuō de huà shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the woman mean by her last remark?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng qǐng nán de bāng tā mǎi diànchí.
choices.english: She wants him to buy her batteries.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 停電久了手機也不能用
choices.simplified: 停电久了手机也不能用
choices.pinyin: Tíngdiàn jiǔ le shǒujī yě bù néng yòng.
choices.english: In a long power cut the phone won't work either.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 男的手機已經快沒電了
choices.simplified: 男的手机已经快没电了
choices.pinyin: Nán de shǒujī yǐjīng kuài méi diàn le.
choices.english: The man's phone is already nearly flat.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā jiālǐ méiyǒu shōuyīnjī.
choices.english: She has no radio at home.

questions.why: He plans to use his phone for the news instead of a radio; she points out that with no power the phone cannot be charged, so it will not last: he should get a radio. She already has batteries (早就準備好了), she never says his phone is low now, and it is he who has no radio.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳上個週末去哪裡了？打電話都找不到妳。
lines.simplified: 你上个周末去哪里了？打电话都找不到你。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shàng ge zhōumò qù nǎlǐ le? Dǎ diànhuà dōu zhǎo bú dào nǐ.
lines.english: Where were you last weekend? I couldn't reach you by phone.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我跟同學帶水跟食物去南部山區救災。那裡一連下了三天大雨，發生了很嚴重的水災。
lines.simplified: 我跟同学带水跟食物去南部山区救灾。那里一连下了三天大雨，发生了很严重的水灾。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ gēn tóngxué dài shuǐ gēn shíwù qù nánbù shānqū jiùzāi. Nàlǐ yìlián xià le sān tiān dàyǔ, fāshēng le hěn yánzhòng de shuǐzāi.
lines.english: I took water and food with some classmates to the mountains in the south to help after the disaster. It rained hard there for three days in a row, and there was a serious flood.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 你們怎麼把東西送過去的？
lines.simplified: 你们怎么把东西送过去的？
lines.pinyin: Nǐmen zěnme bǎ dōngxi sòng guòqù de?
lines.english: How did you get supplies there?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我們本來要開卡車把東西送上山，結果路上都是大石頭，車子過不去，只好在山下把東西發給走下來的災民。
lines.simplified: 我们本来要开卡车把东西送上山，结果路上都是大石头，车子过不去，只好在山下把东西发给走下来的灾民。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen běnlái yào kāi kǎchē bǎ dōngxi sòng shàng shān, jiéguǒ lù shàng dōu shì dà shítou, chēzi guò bú qù, zhǐhǎo zài shān xià bǎ dōngxi fā gěi zǒu xiàlái de zāimín.
lines.english: We meant to drive the supplies up the mountain in a truck, but in the end the road was covered in big rocks and the truck couldn't get through, so we handed the supplies out at the foot of the mountain to the victims who walked down.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那山上的人怎麼辦？
lines.simplified: 那山上的人怎么办？
lines.pinyin: Nà shān shàng de rén zěnme bàn?
lines.english: Then what about the people up the mountain?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 第二天軍隊把路打通了，我們才把剩下的東西送進災區。
lines.simplified: 第二天军队把路打通了，我们才把剩下的东西送进灾区。
lines.pinyin: Dì èr tiān jūnduì bǎ lù dǎtōng le, wǒmen cái bǎ shèngxià de dōngxi sòng jìn zāiqū.
lines.english: The next day the army reopened the road, and only then could we take the rest into the disaster area.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 真辛苦！以後還需要人幫忙的話，有力出力嘛。
lines.simplified: 真辛苦！以后还需要人帮忙的话，有力出力嘛。
lines.pinyin: Zhēn xīnkǔ! Yǐhòu hái xūyào rén bāngmáng de huà, yǒu lì chū lì ma.
lines.english: That must have been hard! If people are needed again some time, those who can help should help.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 第一天，他們帶去的水跟食物後來怎麼了？
prompt.simplified: 第一天，他们带去的水跟食物后来怎么了？
prompt.pinyin: Dì yī tiān, tāmen dài qù de shuǐ gēn shíwù hòulái zěnme le?
prompt.english: On the first day, what happened to the water and food they took?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yòng kǎchē sòng shàng shān le.
choices.english: It was driven up the mountain by truck.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jiāo gěi jūnrén sòng shàng shān.
choices.english: It was given to soldiers to take up.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zài shān xià jiāo gěi le zāimín.
choices.english: It was handed to victims at the foot of the mountain.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yòu dài huí xuéxiào qù le.
choices.english: It was taken back to school.

questions.why: 本來 is the plan (drive it up the mountain) and 結果 gives what really happened that day: the rocks blocked the road, so they gave the supplies out below. The army only cleared the road the next day, and then the students took the rest in themselves.

focus.en: meant to…, but in the end…

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的最後一句話是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 男的最后一句话是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de zuìhòu yí jù huà shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the man mean by his last line?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā yǐhòu yě yuànyì qù bāngmáng
choices.english: He is willing to go and help too next time

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā xiǎng sòng shuǐ gēn shíwù shàng shān
choices.english: He wants to take water and food up the mountain

choices.speaker: N

choices.simplified: 他觉得军队应该早点来
choices.pinyin: Tā juéde jūnduì yīnggāi zǎo diǎn lái
choices.english: He thinks the army should have come sooner

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā juéde nǚ de tài xīnkǔ le
choices.english: He thinks the woman worked too hard

questions.why: 以後還需要人幫忙的話，有力出力嘛: if people are needed again, he will give his effort too, so he is offering to go next time. Taking supplies up the mountain is what the students did, not his plan; he never blames the army; and 真辛苦 is only sympathy, said before his real point.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你看新聞了嗎？昨天的地震規模六點二，好多地方都有災情。
lines.simplified: 你看新闻了吗？昨天的地震规模六点二，好多地方都有灾情。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ kàn xīnwén le ma? Zuótiān de dìzhèn guīmó liù diǎn èr, hǎo duō dìfāng dōu yǒu zāiqíng.
lines.english: Did you see the news? Yesterday's earthquake was magnitude 6.2, and lots of places have damage.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我親眼看到了。那時候我騎車經過車站旁邊，一棟舊大樓突然塌了一半。
lines.simplified: 我亲眼看到了。那时候我骑车经过车站旁边，一栋旧大楼突然塌了一半。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ qīnyǎn kàn dào le. Nà shíhòu wǒ qí chē jīngguò chēzhàn pángbiān, yí dòng jiù dàlóu túrán tā le yíbàn.
lines.english: I saw it with my own eyes. I was riding past the station when an old building suddenly half collapsed.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 太可怕了！有人被困在裡面嗎？
lines.simplified: 太可怕了！有人被困在里面吗？
lines.pinyin: Tài kěpà le! Yǒu rén bèi kùn zài lǐmiàn ma?
lines.english: How terrifying! Was anyone trapped inside?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 有，我聽到底下有人在求救，就馬上打電話給警察。
lines.simplified: 有，我听到底下有人在求救，就马上打电话给警察。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu, wǒ tīng dào dǐxià yǒu rén zài qiújiù, jiù mǎshàng dǎ diànhuà gěi jǐngchá.
lines.english: Yes. I heard someone underneath calling for help, so I phoned the police right away.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 後來呢？
lines.simplified: 后来呢？
lines.pinyin: Hòulái ne?
lines.english: And then?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 警察跟軍人很快就到了，他們要附近的民眾離遠一點，說萬一又地震就危險了。我只好先回家，可是到現在還一直在想那些人怎麼樣了。
lines.simplified: 警察跟军人很快就到了，他们要附近的民众离远一点，说万一又地震就危险了。我只好先回家，可是到现在还一直在想那些人怎么样了。
lines.pinyin: Jǐngchá gēn jūnrén hěn kuài jiù dào le, tāmen yào fùjìn de mínzhòng lí yuǎn yìdiǎn, shuō wànyī yòu dìzhèn jiù wéixiǎn le. Wǒ zhǐhǎo xiān huíjiā, kěshì dào xiànzài hái yìzhí zài xiǎng nàxiē rén zěnmeyàng le.
lines.english: The police and soldiers came quickly, and they told everyone nearby to keep well back, saying it would be dangerous if there were another quake. So I had to go home, but I still keep wondering what happened to those people.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 警察到了以後，男的怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 警察到了以后，男的怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Jǐngchá dào le yǐhòu, nán de zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What happened to the man after the police arrived?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bǎ rén jiù le chūlái.
choices.english: He got the people out.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bèi yāoqiú líkāi nàlǐ.
choices.english: He was asked to leave the spot.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Liú xiàlái bāngmáng zhǎo rén.
choices.english: He stayed to help search.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yòu dǎ le yí cì diànhuà.
choices.english: He phoned again.

questions.why: 他們要附近的民眾離遠一點……我只好先回家: the police sent the onlookers away, so he went home. He only heard the people calling for help; he never got them out or stayed to search, and the phone call came before the police arrived.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的現在心情怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 男的现在心情怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de xiànzài xīnqíng zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: How does the man feel now?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Hěn gāoxìng zìjǐ méi shì.
choices.english: He is glad he is unhurt.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Juéde jǐngchá zuò de bú duì.
choices.english: He thinks the police were wrong.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Pà děng yíxià yòu huì dìzhèn.
choices.english: He fears another quake any moment.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Hái zài dānxīn nàxiē rén.
choices.english: He is still worried about those people.

questions.why: 到現在還一直在想那些人怎麼樣了: he keeps wondering about the trapped people, which is worry. He never says he is glad to be safe; the fear of another quake is the police's reason, not his feeling now; and he accepts the police's reason (萬一又地震就危險了) rather than blaming them.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段廣播，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段广播，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn guǎngbò, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a radio broadcast, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 各位聽眾晚安，現在報告最新的地震消息。今天下午三點十分發生了規模六點五的強烈地震，位置在花蓮東邊的海上，臺北跟臺中也感覺得到。
lines.simplified: 各位听众晚安，现在报告最新的地震消息。今天下午三点十分发生了规模六点五的强烈地震，位置在花莲东边的海上，台北跟台中也感觉得到。
lines.pinyin: Gèwèi tīngzhòng wǎn'ān, xiànzài bàogào zuì xīn de dìzhèn xiāoxí. Jīntiān xiàwǔ sān diǎn shí fēn fāshēng le guīmó liù diǎn wǔ de qiángliè dìzhèn, wèizhì zài Huālián dōngbiān de hǎi shàng, Táiběi gēn Táizhōng yě gǎnjué de dào.
lines.english: Good evening, listeners. Here is the latest earthquake news. At ten past three this afternoon a strong magnitude 6.5 earthquake struck, centred at sea east of Hualien. It was felt in Taipei and Taichung too.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這次地震造成了一些災情：花蓮以南的山區有好幾條路因為山上有大石頭掉下來而不通，請民眾這幾天不要開車上山。到現在還沒有房屋倒塌的消息。
lines.simplified: 这次地震造成了一些灾情：花莲以南的山区有好几条路因为山上有大石头掉下来而不通，请民众这几天不要开车上山。到现在还没有房屋倒塌的消息。
lines.pinyin: Zhè cì dìzhèn zàochéng le yìxiē zāiqíng: Huālián yǐ nán de shānqū yǒu hǎo jǐ tiáo lù yīnwèi shān shàng yǒu dà shítou diào xiàlái ér bù tōng, qǐng mínzhòng zhè jǐ tiān bú yào kāichē shàng shān. Dào xiànzài hái méiyǒu fángwū dǎotā de xiāoxí.
lines.english: The quake has caused some damage: in the mountains south of Hualien, several roads are closed because big rocks have fallen onto them, and the public is asked not to drive up into the mountains for the next few days. So far there is no news of any buildings collapsing.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 研究人員說，這兩天可能還會再發生地震，請大家把收音機跟電池準備好，萬一停電，也能聽到最新的廣播。
lines.simplified: 研究人员说，这两天可能还会再发生地震，请大家把收音机跟电池准备好，万一停电，也能听到最新的广播。
lines.pinyin: Yánjiù rényuán shuō, zhè liǎng tiān kěnéng hái huì zài fāshēng dìzhèn, qǐng dàjiā bǎ shōuyīnjī gēn diànchí zhǔnbèi hǎo, wànyī tíngdiàn, yě néng tīng dào zuì xīn de guǎngbò.
lines.english: Researchers say there may be further earthquakes over the next two days. Please get your radio and batteries ready, so that if the power goes out you can still hear the latest broadcasts.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 哪裡的路現在不能走？
prompt.simplified: 哪里的路现在不能走？
prompt.pinyin: Nǎlǐ de lù xiànzài bù néng zǒu?
prompt.english: Where are the roads closed now?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Huālián běibiān de shān shàng.
choices.english: In the mountains north of Hualien.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Huālián dōngbiān de hǎibiān.
choices.english: On the coast east of Hualien.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Táizhōng fùjìn de shānqū.
choices.english: In the mountains near Taichung.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Huālián nánbiān de shān shàng.
choices.english: In the mountains south of Hualien.

questions.why: 花蓮以南的山區……不通: 以南 means the area south of Hualien. East of Hualien is where the quake happened, at sea, and Taichung is only a place where it was felt.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 下面哪一個是廣播裡說的？
prompt.simplified: 下面哪一个是广播里说的？
prompt.pinyin: Xiàmiàn nǎ yí ge shì guǎngbò lǐ shuō de?
prompt.english: Which of these does the broadcast say?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Táiběi yǒu fángzi dǎo le.
choices.english: Houses fell down in Taipei.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jiē xiàlái hái kěnéng yǒu dìzhèn.
choices.english: More earthquakes may follow.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dìzhèn fāshēng zài bànyè.
choices.english: The quake happened at midnight.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiànzài yǐjīng tíngdiàn le.
choices.english: The power is already out.

questions.why: 這兩天可能還會再發生地震: more quakes may come. Taipei only felt it and no building has fallen anywhere yet; it struck at ten past three in the afternoon, and the power cut is only something to prepare for (萬一停電).

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段留言，然後回答兩個問題。

intro.english: Listen to a voice message, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 同學你好，我是上星期打電話給你的救災活動負責人。這次颱風在臺東造成很嚴重的水災，我們要去災區幫災民整理房子。星期六早上七點在學校門口集合，大家坐巴士，東西用卡車送過去。
lines.simplified: 同学你好，我是上星期打电话给你的救灾活动负责人。这次台风在台东造成很严重的水灾，我们要去灾区帮灾民整理房子。星期六早上七点在学校门口集合，大家坐巴士，东西用卡车送过去。

Zhè cì táifēng zài Táidōng zàochéng hěn yánzhòng de shuǐzāi, wǒmen yào qù zāiqū bāng zāimín zhěnglǐ fángzi. Xīngqíliù zǎoshàng qī diǎn zài xuéxiào ménkǒu jíhé, dàjiā zuò bāshì, dōngxi yòng kǎchē sòng guòqù.
lines.english: Hello, this is the organiser of the relief trip who phoned you last week. This typhoon caused serious flooding in Taitung, and we are going to the disaster area to help the victims clean up their homes. We gather at the school gate at seven on Saturday morning; we go by bus and the supplies go by truck.

lines.traditional: 因為臺東市以北的路還沒通，我們得先往南開，再從南邊進去，大概要花五個小時才能到達。那裡停水停電，請自己帶水跟吃的，衣服也多帶一套。到了以後不要一個人進山區，萬一發生意外就不好了，生命安全最要緊。如果你那天不能來，請在星期五中午以前打電話告訴我。

Běnlái wǎnshàng de fēngyǔ bú dà, wǒmen dōu yǐwéi táifēng bú huì lái le, méixiǎngdào bànyè liǎng diǎn, fēngyǔ túrán biàn dà, wàipó jiā zhōuwéi de shùmù bèi chuī dǎo le hǎo jǐ kē. Dì èr tiān zǎoshàng, wǒ xiǎng kāichē dài wàipó xià shān, jiéguǒ lù shàng dōu shì dà shítou, chēzi wánquán guò bú qù. Jiālǐ tíngshuǐ tíngdiàn, shènzhì lián shǒujī dōu méi diàn le, wǒmen méi bànfǎ dǎ diànhuà qiújiù. Yìzhí dào dì sān tiān xiàwǔ, jiùzāi rényuán cái zǒulù shàng shān, dàodá wàipó jiā. Wàipó shuō, jiùsuàn yǐhòu zài yǒu táifēng, tā yě bù xiǎng bān xià shān qù zhù.
passage.english: Last month, when the typhoon came, I happened to be at my grandmother's home in the mountains. At first the wind and rain that evening were light, and we thought the typhoon wasn't coming. But at two in the morning the storm suddenly grew strong, and several of the trees around Grandma's house were blown down. The next morning I wanted to drive Grandma down the mountain, but in the end the road was covered in big rocks and the car could not get through at all. We had no water or power, and even our phones went flat, so we could not phone for help. Not until the afternoon of the third day did rescue workers walk up the mountain and reach Grandma's house. Grandma says that even if more typhoons come, she still does not want to move down the mountain.

Yǒu yì tiān wǎnshàng, yí wèi lǎo xiānshēng diǎn làzhú de shíhòu bù xiǎoxīn, yǐnqǐ le yì chǎng xiǎo huǒzāi. Háihǎo línjū mǎshàng pǎo lái, dàjiā bǎ lìliàng jíhé qǐlái, yǒude tí shuǐ, yǒude dǎ diànhuà, suǒyǐ méiyǒu rén shòushāng. Cóng nà cì yǐhòu, shèqū měi ge yuè dōu kāi yí cì huì, jiāo dàjiā zěnme jiàngdī huǒzāi de wéixiǎn. Fùzé guǎnlǐ shèqū de rén bùjǐn zài huì shàng shuōmíng, hái yì jiā yì jiā qù wèn dàjiā zhǔnbèi hǎo le méiyǒu. Tā yě gàosu dàjiā, jiālǐ yào zhǔnbèi hǎo yòng diànchí de dēng, wànyī yòu tíngdiàn, jiù búbì diǎn làzhú le.
passage.english: Most of the houses in our neighbourhood are old and built close together. When the typhoon came last month, the neighbourhood was without power for three days in a row, and many people had to light candles. One evening an old man was careless while lighting a candle and started a small fire. Luckily the neighbours ran over at once, and everyone pooled their strength: some carried water, some made phone calls, so nobody was hurt. Since then the neighbourhood has held a meeting every month to teach people how to lower the risk of fire. The person who runs the neighbourhood not only explains things at the meetings but also goes from home to home asking whether people are prepared. He also tells everyone to keep battery lamps ready at home, so that if the power goes out again they will not need candles.

text.traditional:
臺灣是太平洋上的海島，因為地理位置的關係，一年到頭大小地震不斷。我在一所國小教書，學校每個月都會做一次地震練習：老師一說「地震來了」，學生就要馬上到桌子底下，等地震停了，再到操場集合。剛開始，不少家長覺得這是白花上課時間，甚至有人打電話到學校，希望學校別再做這種練習了。
去年十月的一個早上，突然發生了一場規模六點一的地震。教室的電燈不停地擺動，書都掉到了地上，有幾個學生嚇哭了。可是大家都記得練習時學的方法，沒有人亂跑。地震一停，大家就安靜地走到操場。後來我們才知道，那天學校一千多個學生，沒有一個受傷。從那天起，再也沒有家長說練習是白花時間了。
人們沒辦法知道地震什麼時候會來。我想，練習的意義不是讓人不怕地震，而是讓人在害怕的時候，還知道應該怎麼做。
text.simplified:
台湾是太平洋上的海岛，因为地理位置的关系，一年到头大小地震不断。我在一所国小教书，学校每个月都会做一次地震练习：老师一说「地震来了」，学生就要马上到桌子底下，等地震停了，再到操场集合。刚开始，不少家长觉得这是白花上课时间，甚至有人打电话到学校，希望学校别再做这种练习了。
去年十月的一个早上，突然发生了一场规模六点一的地震。教室的电灯不停地摆动，书都掉到了地上，有几个学生吓哭了。可是大家都记得练习时学的方法，没有人乱跑。地震一停，大家就安静地走到操场。后来我们才知道，那天学校一千多个学生，没有一个受伤。从那天起，再也没有家长说练习是白花时间了。
人们没办法知道地震什么时候会来。我想，练习的意义不是让人不怕地震，而是让人在害怕的时候，还知道应该怎么做。
text.pinyin: Táiwān shì Tàipíngyáng shàng de hǎidǎo, yīnwèi dìlǐ wèizhì de guānxi, yì nián dào tóu dàxiǎo dìzhèn búduàn. Wǒ zài yì suǒ guóxiǎo jiāoshū, xuéxiào měi ge yuè dōu huì zuò yí cì dìzhèn liànxí: lǎoshī yì shuō "dìzhèn lái le", xuéshēng jiù yào mǎshàng dào zhuōzi dǐxià, děng dìzhèn tíng le, zài dào cāochǎng jíhé. Gāng kāishǐ, bùshǎo jiāzhǎng juéde zhè shì bái huā shàngkè shíjiān, shènzhì yǒu rén dǎ diànhuà dào xuéxiào, xīwàng xuéxiào bié zài zuò zhè zhǒng liànxí le. Qùnián shí yuè de yí ge zǎoshàng, túrán fāshēng le yì chǎng guīmó liù diǎn yī de dìzhèn. Jiàoshì de diàndēng bù tíng de bǎidòng, shū dōu diào dào le dì shàng, yǒu jǐ ge xuéshēng xià kū le. Kěshì dàjiā dōu jìde liànxí shí xué de fāngfǎ, méiyǒu rén luàn pǎo. Dìzhèn yì tíng, dàjiā jiù ānjìng de zǒu dào cāochǎng. Hòulái wǒmen cái zhīdào, nà tiān xuéxiào yì qiān duō ge xuéshēng, méiyǒu yí ge shòushāng. Cóng nà tiān qǐ, zài yě méiyǒu jiāzhǎng shuō liànxí shì bái huā shíjiān le. Rénmen méi bànfǎ zhīdào dìzhèn shénme shíhòu huì lái. Wǒ xiǎng, liànxí de yìyì bú shì ràng rén bú pà dìzhèn, ér shì ràng rén zài hàipà de shíhòu, hái zhīdào yīnggāi zěnme zuò.
text.english:
Taiwan is an island in the Pacific, and because of where it lies, earthquakes large and small never stop all year round. I teach at a primary school, and every month the school holds an earthquake drill: as soon as a teacher says "Earthquake!", the pupils must get under their desks at once, and when the shaking stops they gather on the sports field. At first quite a few parents felt this wasted class time; some even phoned the school asking it to stop the drills.
One morning last October a magnitude 6.1 earthquake suddenly struck. The classroom lights swung back and forth, books fell to the floor, and a few pupils burst into tears. But everyone remembered what they had learned in the drills, and nobody ran about. As soon as the shaking stopped, everyone walked quietly to the sports field. We learned afterwards that of the school's more than a thousand pupils, not one was hurt that day. From then on, no parent ever again said the drills were a waste of time.
Nobody can know when an earthquake will come. I think the point of practising is not to make people unafraid of earthquakes, but to make sure that even when they are afraid, they still know what to do.

title.english: What to Check Before You Rent

text.traditional:
很多人租房子的時候，最先想到的是房租跟交通，很少想到颱風和地震。我剛來臺灣時也一樣，租了一間離學校很近、房租又便宜的一樓小房間。沒想到第一個颱風來，那條路一連淹了兩天水，房間裡的東西都被水弄壞了，甚至連護照都差一點救不回來。
後來我問了鄰居，才知道那附近本來就是很低的地帶，每年都會淹水。現在我租房子，一定先做三件事：第一，問問鄰居，這附近以前有沒有淹過水；第二，看看房屋有多老，屋頂有沒有問題；第三，看看周圍有沒有大樹，颱風天萬一樹倒了，可能會把窗戶打破。這些事花不了多少時間，可是能讓人住得放心。
text.simplified:
很多人租房子的时候，最先想到的是房租跟交通，很少想到台风和地震。我刚来台湾时也一样，租了一间离学校很近、房租又便宜的一楼小房间。没想到第一个台风来，那条路一连淹了两天水，房间里的东西都被水弄坏了，甚至连护照都差一点救不回来。
后来我问了邻居，才知道那附近本来就是很低的地带，每年都会淹水。现在我租房子，一定先做三件事：第一，问问邻居，这附近以前有没有淹过水；第二，看看房屋有多老，屋顶有没有问题；第三，看看周围有没有大树，台风天万一树倒了，可能会把窗户打破。这些事花不了多少时间，可是能让人住得放心。
text.pinyin: Hěn duō rén zū fángzi de shíhòu, zuì xiān xiǎng dào de shì fángzū gēn jiāotōng, hěn shǎo xiǎng dào táifēng hé dìzhèn. Wǒ gāng lái Táiwān shí yě yíyàng, zū le yì jiān lí xuéxiào hěn jìn, fángzū yòu piányí de yī lóu xiǎo fángjiān. Méixiǎngdào dì yī ge táifēng lái, nà tiáo lù yìlián yān le liǎng tiān shuǐ, fángjiān lǐ de dōngxi dōu bèi shuǐ nòng huài le, shènzhì lián hùzhào dōu chà yìdiǎn jiù bù huílái. Hòulái wǒ wèn le línjū, cái zhīdào nà fùjìn běnlái jiù shì hěn dī de dìdài, měi nián dōu huì yānshuǐ. Xiànzài wǒ zū fángzi, yídìng xiān zuò sān jiàn shì: dì yī, wènwèn línjū, zhè fùjìn yǐqián yǒu méiyǒu yān guo shuǐ; dì èr, kànkàn fángwū yǒu duō lǎo, wūdǐng yǒu méiyǒu wèntí; dì sān, kànkàn zhōuwéi yǒu méiyǒu dà shù, táifēng tiān wànyī shù dǎo le, kěnéng huì bǎ chuānghù dǎ pò. Zhèxiē shì huā bù liǎo duōshǎo shíjiān, kěshì néng ràng rén zhù de fàngxīn.
text.english:
When renting, most people think first about the rent and transport and seldom about typhoons and earthquakes. When I first came to Taiwan I was the same: I rented a small ground-floor room close to school and cheap as well. But when the first typhoon came, that street was flooded for two days in a row, everything in my room was ruined by water, and I very nearly lost even my passport.
Later I asked the neighbours and learned that the neighbourhood has always been a low-lying area that floods every year. Now, when I rent, I always do three things first: one, ask the neighbours whether this area has flooded before; two, see how old the building is and whether the roof has any problems; three, see whether there are big trees around it, because if a tree happens to fall in a typhoon it may smash the windows. These things take little time, but they let you live without worry.

text.traditional: 我姊姊上個月生了一對雙胞胎。孩子滿月那天，家人本來要在餐廳請客，請大家吃油飯和紅蛋，沒想到前一天新聞說颱風要來了。姊姊想來想去，還是決定把請客的地方改到家裡。那天外面風雨很大，可是客人還是一個一個來了。外婆一進門就抱著孩子不放，外公一整個晚上除了幫孩子拍照，就是一直說「好可愛的孩子啊！」大家吃著油飯，聽著外面的風雨聲，一點也不覺得颱風天可怕。晚上九點，突然停電了，哥哥把蠟燭點了起來，兩個孩子不但沒哭，還在蠟燭旁邊睡著了。姊姊說，這是她最珍貴的回憶。
text.simplified: 我姊姊上个月生了一对双胞胎。孩子满月那天，家人本来要在餐厅请客，请大家吃油饭和红蛋，没想到前一天新闻说台风要来了。姊姊想来想去，还是决定把请客的地方改到家里。那天外面风雨很大，可是客人还是一个一个来了。外婆一进门就抱着孩子不放，外公一整个晚上除了帮孩子拍照，就是一直说「好可爱的孩子啊！」大家吃着油饭，听着外面的风雨声，一点也不觉得台风天可怕。晚上九点，突然停电了，哥哥把蜡烛点了起来，两个孩子不但没哭，还在蜡烛旁边睡着了。姊姊说，这是她最珍贵的回忆。
text.pinyin: Wǒ jiějie shàng ge yuè shēng le yí duì shuāngbāotāi. Háizi mǎnyuè nà tiān, jiārén běnlái yào zài cāntīng qǐngkè, qǐng dàjiā chī yóufàn hé hóngdàn, méixiǎngdào qián yì tiān xīnwén shuō táifēng yào lái le. Jiějie xiǎng lái xiǎng qù, háishì juédìng bǎ qǐngkè de dìfāng gǎi dào jiālǐ. Nà tiān wàimiàn fēngyǔ hěn dà, kěshì kèrén háishì yí ge yí ge lái le. Wàipó yí jìn mén jiù bào zhe háizi bú fàng, wàigōng yì zhěng ge wǎnshàng chúle bāng háizi pāizhào, jiù shì yìzhí shuō "Hǎo kě'ài de háizi a!" Dàjiā chī zhe yóufàn, tīng zhe wàimiàn de fēngyǔshēng, yìdiǎn yě bù juéde táifēng tiān kěpà. Wǎnshàng jiǔ diǎn, túrán tíngdiàn le, gēge bǎ làzhú diǎn le qǐlái, liǎng ge háizi búdàn méi kū, hái zài làzhú pángbiān shuì zháo le. Jiějie shuō, zhè shì tā zuì zhēnguì de huíyì.
text.english: Last month my older sister had twins. For their one-month celebration the family meant to hold a party at a restaurant and treat everyone to sticky rice and red eggs, but the day before, the news said a typhoon was coming. After thinking it over and over, my sister decided to move the party home. That day the storm was fierce outside, yet the guests still came one by one. Grandma took the babies in her arms the moment she arrived and would not let go; all evening Grandpa did nothing but take photos of the babies and keep saying, "What lovely children!" Eating sticky rice and listening to the wind and rain outside, nobody felt the typhoon was frightening at all. At nine in the evening the power suddenly went out, and my brother lit some candles. The two babies did not cry; they fell asleep beside the candles. My sister says it is her most precious memory.

text.traditional: 颱風天，很多商店都關門了，可是我家附近的超商還是開著。上次颱風來，我家停了一整天的電，手機也快沒電了，我只好穿著雨衣走到超商。店裡已經有很多人，店員不但讓大家在店裡休息，還提供熱水，讓我們用熱水來泡麵。我順便買了電池，準備回家的時候，才發現店員早就把店裡的收音機打開了，大家一邊吃，一邊聽颱風的最新消息。那時我才明白，對很多人來說，超商在颱風天不只是買東西的地方，也是一個讓人放心的地方。
text.simplified: 台风天，很多商店都关门了，可是我家附近的超商还是开着。上次台风来，我家停了一整天的电，手机也快没电了，我只好穿着雨衣走到超商。店里已经有很多人，店员不但让大家在店里休息，还提供热水，让我们用热水来泡面。我顺便买了电池，准备回家的时候，才发现店员早就把店里的收音机打开了，大家一边吃，一边听台风的最新消息。那时我才明白，对很多人来说，超商在台风天不只是买东西的地方，也是一个让人放心的地方。
text.pinyin: Táifēng tiān, hěn duō shāngdiàn dōu guānmén le, kěshì wǒ jiā fùjìn de chāoshāng háishì kāi zhe. Shàng cì táifēng lái, wǒ jiā tíng le yì zhěng tiān de diàn, shǒujī yě kuài méi diàn le, wǒ zhǐhǎo chuān zhe yǔyī zǒu dào chāoshāng. Diàn lǐ yǐjīng yǒu hěn duō rén, diànyuán búdàn ràng dàjiā zài diàn lǐ xiūxí, hái tígōng rèshuǐ, ràng wǒmen yòng rèshuǐ lái pào miàn. Wǒ shùnbiàn mǎi le diànchí, zhǔnbèi huíjiā de shíhòu, cái fāxiàn diànyuán zǎo jiù bǎ diàn lǐ de shōuyīnjī dǎkāi le, dàjiā yìbiān chī, yìbiān tīng táifēng de zuì xīn xiāoxí. Nà shí wǒ cái míngbái, duì hěn duō rén lái shuō, chāoshāng zài táifēng tiān bù zhǐ shì mǎi dōngxi de dìfāng, yě shì yí ge ràng rén fàngxīn de dìfāng.
text.english: On typhoon days many shops close, but the convenience store near my home stays open. Last time a typhoon came, we had no power at home for a whole day and my phone was nearly flat, so I put on a raincoat and walked to the store. It was already full of people. The staff not only let everyone rest inside but also provided hot water so we could make instant noodles with it. While I was there I bought batteries, and as I was about to go home I noticed the staff had long since switched on the store's radio, so everyone was eating and listening to the latest typhoon news. Only then did I understand that for many people a convenience store on a typhoon day is not just a place to shop, but also a place that puts their minds at ease.
